title: Founder Studio S12: business metrics of the golden SYNTHETIC founder scenarios
disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.
scope: The golden SYNTHETIC founder scenarios of S4/S6: 6 business types x (5 real metros + the SYNTHETIC metro). The S12 prompt's 30 scenarios are the real-metro subset, reported separately where a metric is measured here.
baseline: B0: a plan made without SiteIQ, the simulation and the ledger, built from the same SYNTHETIC inputs and documents: the founder's typed figures, the untyped inputs at their most likely value, and years 1-3 revenue, NOI, debt service and DSCR of the one-forecast run. A figure carries a source only when it is a founder figure every document about it agrees with. A construction, not a sample of real plans (docs/studio/s12_baseline.md).

configuration.narrative_and_memo: template narrative and deterministic template memo (FAKE LLM - test mode)

headline.time_label: machine-dependent wall-clock measurement on the machine that ran the script (shared; CPU count and load average in the provenance block); not a user time: it excludes the founder's time to gather inputs and documents, and nobody's time was observed

founder_figures_backed_by_a_document.expected: expected equal by construction: the same documents and the same tolerance decide both plans

headline.compute_cost: not measured: no cloud resource was used and the machine's cost is not metered
headline.usability_test: not measured: no usability test with real people was done, so there is no n, protocol or raw time

time_to_complete_package.label: machine-dependent wall-clock measurement on the machine that ran the script (shared; CPU count and load average in the provenance block); not a user time: it excludes the founder's time to gather inputs and documents, and nobody's time was observed
time_to_complete_package.definition: seconds from a scenario's inputs to an audited PDF: golden scenario (SiteIQ when tracts exist, the simulation, the quick path search) + build_package + render_pdf + PDF round-trip audit and page-label check; the handoff is timed apart and is not part of it
time_to_complete_package.first_scenario_note: the first scenario of a process also loads configs and fills caches once
time_to_complete_package.handoff_note: the first handoff of a process also loads the screening lists (agent.tools.screening_handler loads them on first call), so its time includes that one-time load; handoff_s_without_first_scenario leaves it out
time_to_complete_package.baseline_b0: not measured: no one was timed writing a plan

rule_s_checkable_source.definition: share of printed figures with a checkable source: VERIFIED, MODEL_ESTIMATE or CONFLICTING claims of kind document, public_data, policy, calculation or model, and ASSUMPTION claims whose source is not 'unsourced'
rule_s_checkable_source.baseline_rule: a B0 figure carries a source only when it is a founder figure and every document about that field prints the same value (ledger tolerance); B0 has no ledger to record any other source (definition, not observation)

rule_e_external_evidence.definition: share of printed figures backed by a document page, a public-data row or a program or target section
rule_e_external_evidence.baseline_rule: a B0 figure carries a source only when it is a founder figure and every document about that field prints the same value (ledger tolerance); B0 has no ledger to record any other source (definition, not observation)

founder_figures_backed_by_a_document.population: the founder's typed plan and loan figures (founder_claims.FIELD_SPECS fields with a value)
founder_figures_backed_by_a_document.expected: expected equal by construction: the same documents and the same tolerance decide both plans

conflicts_surfaced.baseline_b0: none by definition: B0 has no step that compares a typed figure with a document (not a measurement)

evidence_coverage.reading: Most of the Studio - B0 gap follows from the definitions: model estimates and calculations count for Studio because the ledger records their run or formula and inputs, and B0 prints no such record. Rule E removes that credit; the founder-figure comparison uses one population for both and is equal by construction. B0 is a construction from the same SYNTHETIC inputs, not a sample of real founders' plans.

printed_numbers_trace_to_a_ledger_claim.baseline_b0: not applicable: B0 has no ledger to trace a number to

cited.definition: Data coverage per metro x business type x factor (Studio S1). status: DATA = public dataset value; SYNTHETIC = generated city; ASSUMPTION = the project author's labeled range; DATA_X_ASSUMPTION = a public value converted with a labeled assumption (QCEW weekly wage / assumed hours); UNKNOWN = no data. coverage_share = weighted share of a business type's required factors backed by data (DATA or SYNTHETIC) times the share of tracts covered; everything else counts as 0. live_per_site = the layer has no per-tract values but can be looked up live for one site (UNKNOWN for ranking tracts).

cited.definition: share of plans that do not meet the three targets as they are for which the search returns at least one change-set of one or two levers inside the default bounds that meets all three
cited.scope: Seeded SYNTHETIC plans (src/uwcopilot/studio/path_to_approval/synthetic_plans.py) searched on the SYNTHETIC metro and on each real metro in its current mode. The path-found rate depends on how the plans are generated and on the editable targets and lever bounds; it describes the search on these plans, not any real founder's chances.
cited.real_world_accuracy: not measured: no real founder outcomes exist; every plan is SYNTHETIC

path_found_rate.this_run_note: path-search status of the golden scenarios in this run: a description of these seeded plans, not an estimate of the path-found rate (the cited S5 rate is the estimate)
path_found_rate.baseline_b0: not applicable: B0 has no path search
